book.title: Traction: Get a Grip on Your Business
book.author: Gino Wickman

confidence_note: Engineer example and definitions from a summary; capacity wording and 'ask for every seat' from general EOS knowledge. Old salesperson anecdote dropped.
facts: Right people share core values; right seats fit by GWC.
GWC: Get it, Want it, Capacity to do it; a no on any means not right for that seat.
Capacity covers mental, physical and emotional strength and time.
People Analyzer rates each person on each core value: most of the time, sometimes, never.
Example: an engineer gets an executive role and has the capacity but does not want it.
opening_idea: An engineer who does not want the executive seat.

lessons.idea: Test a role with three questions.

reflect_final: Which of get, want, capacity is missing in a role you hold?

use_cases.situation: Offering an employee a new role
use_cases.move: Do you want it? Do you have the time and energy?

use_cases.situation: Making a high performer a manager
use_cases.move: Get it, want it, capacity: all three yes before we decide.
I can do it, but do I want it? Write it down.

pocket_idea: Grasp, want, capacity: if one says no, the problem may be the seat.

conversation_variants.punchline_idea: A capable person who does not want the seat is not the right fit.
